records.label: Somayazulu et al. (2023), BM3 + MGD
records.note: Independently checked against the cited primary publication (published article or official/author copy); no external software catalog was used as scientific authority.

locations: official supplementary material, equations 1-9 and Tables 3-4
primary_source_check.finding: The article and supplement define an integrated constant-q MGD model that Peritheos represents exactly. The article's final gamma0=0.8, q=2.1 parameterization gives a 1.39 GPa pressure RMSE on the 41 heated supplementary points. A Peritheos P-V-T errors-in-variables refit with gamma0 fixed gives q=1.050(519), rather than independently recovering q=2.1. Source contradictions in EOS order, theta0, gamma0/q, and nominal reference temperature are retained explicitly with evidence-based resolutions.

records.label: Somayazulu et al. (2023), BM3 + Berman thermal reference state
records.note: Equation, parameters, fixed quantities, EosFit7c fitting method, primary P-V-T table, and diffraction structure were checked against the article and official supplement.

primary_source_check.finding: Source inspection shows that EosFit7's Berman implementation uses a truncated quadratic reference-volume law and effective-variance pressure weights. The article displays an exponential-integral formula that instead matches EosFit's Fei-style law. Peritheos stores the actual EosFit Berman curve and documents both fitting objectives.

records.label: Somayazulu et al. (2023), BM3 + Berman public-data refit
records.note: Primary dataset, equation choices, fixed quantities, and pressure calibration were checked against the article and official supplement; refitted values were independently reproduced with EosFit7c and Peritheos.

primary_source_check.finding: A direct EosFit7c 7.60 run on the 41 heated public-data rows gives alpha0=1.81120e-5 +/- 0.21554e-5 K^-1, dK0/dT=-0.01311 +/- 0.00419 GPa/K, reduced weighted chi-square 1.0412, and correlation -0.958. Peritheos's matched effective-variance emulation reproduces these values within printed precision.
